title: Context footprint after the #368–#372 cuts (main 1.42.0 + lean tools/list): tool list still ~0.7k tok over the 8k target; pre-edit grounding ~1.5k tok per busy file is ungated
observation: Re-measured 2026-09-27 with `hunch footprint` (chars/4) on main plus branch feat/lean-tool-list. MET targets of dec_3ca27de266: grounding block 3,697 chars (~925 tok, target ≤1k); per-prompt 328 reminder + 806 task instruction first time (~284 tok), 377 compact after (~95 tok; target ≤400); hunch_context result 7,060 chars for a 1,500-tok budget (1.18×, target ≤1.5×). NOT MET: tools/list ≤8k tok. Default toolset on an empty store is 34,883 chars (~8.7k tok) after the lean pass, down from 37,824. Without outputSchema, which is what function-calling hosts forward as name + description + parameters, it is 28,085 (~7.0k tok, meets the target). This repo has the policy group on (34 tools): 39,894 (~10.0k tok). The largest remaining item is the hunch_context outputSchema at 5,349 chars; it advertises the execution-obligation item schema twice (hypotheses[].obligations and top-level obligations). UNGATED: pre-edit (PreToolUse) grounding is 6,209 chars (~1.55k tok) on the first touch of src/mcp/server.ts, 6,215 for src/integrations/claudemd.ts, 6,201 for src/cli/index.ts, and 413 for src/core/io.ts. The builder fills the full 1,500-tok budget. It includes a RECENT TASKS supplement (up to ~1.3k chars) chosen by fuzzy query overlap, so even a brand-new file (test/lean-tool-list.test.ts) received 4 unrelated task lines. It is not in `hunch footprint` (listed as unmeasured), and neither is SessionStart orientation.
